landing.f1Body: Trade without ever holding ETH, BNB or SOL — Kamby pays the network fees on every chain.
landing.f2Body: Every swap is simulated before it’s sent, and coins are honeypot-checked before they’re listed.
landing.f3Body: One balance across Solana, Base, BNB and Robinhood — Kamby moves it to the right chain when you trade.
landing.f4Body: Create your own coin in a minute on Pump.fun, Clanker or Four.meme — paid in USDC, first buy included.
landing.f5Body: Talk, react and see real trades stream in — with 🐳, ⚡ and 👑 badges that can’t be faked.
landing.f6Body: Beautiful share cards with your invite link on them — every win brings new traders.
landing.showcaseBody: One tap turns a trade into a card made for X, Instagram and TikTok — your real numbers, your name, your invite link.
landing.heroSub: Find coins, follow whales and chat with other traders — all with just USDC, no gas.
landing.chatBody: A worldwide chat for every trader, and a live chat on every coin — with real trades streaming in and badges that can’t be faked.
landing.howTitle: From zero to your first trade in a minute
landing.howSub: No seed phrase, no gas coins, no bridges to figure out.
landing.step1Title: Sign in with email or Google
landing.step1Body: Your own wallet is created for you in seconds. Nothing to install, no seed phrase to write down.
landing.step2Body: One dollar balance for every chain. Send USDC from an exchange or another wallet — that’s all you ever hold.
landing.step3Body: Pick a coin, tap buy. Kamby pays the network fee and checks the swap before it goes out.
landing.tourTitle: Everything a trader needs, in one tap
landing.tourSub: Tap a tab — or just watch.
landing.hoodTitle: What happens when you tap Buy
landing.hoodSub: Five steps in about a second — here’s what Kamby does for you.
landing.h1b: You choose an amount in USDC. No gas coin, no other token needed.
landing.h2b: Kamby asks every exchange on that chain — Jupiter on Solana, KyberSwap on Base, BNB and Robinhood — and takes the best route.
landing.h3b: The swap is simulated first and the coin is checked for traps (honeypots). If something’s wrong, it never goes out.
landing.h4b: The wallet is yours. Kamby never holds your keys and can’t move your money.
landing.h5b: The network fee is on us. The coin lands in your wallet in seconds and your profit is tracked on its own.
landing.q1: Do I need a crypto wallet?
landing.a1: No. Sign in with email or Google and a wallet is created for you automatically — it belongs to you.
landing.a2: No. Kamby covers the network fees on every chain. You only ever hold USDC.
landing.a3: You do. Kamby is non-custodial — your funds sit in your own wallet and only you can sign a trade.
landing.q4: Which chains can I trade on?
landing.a4: Solana, Base, BNB Chain and Robinhood Chain — all from the same USDC balance.
landing.a5: Every swap is simulated and every coin is checked for honeypots before you trade. Meme coins are still very risky — only trade what you can afford to lose.
landing.liveBody: Streams made for trading: the host shares their screen, every buy lands in chat, and you can copy it in one tap.
landing.livePoint1Body: Their chart, their positions and their camera — under a second behind.
landing.livePoint2Body: A trade in chat has a Buy button. Gasless, with just USDC.
landing.livePoint3Body: Send a tip from $5, throw reactions, get pinned to the top of chat.
landing.feedTitle: Post your trades, not just your opinions.
landing.feedBody: Every post can carry a real Trade Card or PnL card from your actual position — nobody can fake the numbers. Add a chart, a photo or a clip.
